name: preloader
title: Preloader
description: Material circular spinner with Materialize's exact timings, three sizes and a four-color mode.
improvements: One component instead of fifteen nested divs to copy by hand.
role="status" with an accessible label ("Loading" by default).
Any theme color or CSS color, not only the four built-in Google colors.
With reduced motion the arc stops filling and unfilling and only turns slowly.
